pages.text: Beetle desert: sand and red-sand dunes over Chitinstone with buried bone. The dips between dunes are Glowmarl flats where everything grows, including the pale, spiralling $(item)Ribwood$() trees. Banded Chitinstone pillars hold up the dome.
pages.title: Desert Meteor

pages.text: Rattles when you walk through it, and the noise alerts nearby beetles. Sneak to stay quiet.
